# FTP / FTPS (File Search) MCP connector

Search inside the documents on an FTP or FTPS server from your AI client: PDF, Excel, Word and Outlook files indexed and synced by AnythingMCP File Search. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 10 MCP tools for FTP / FTPS (File Search).

[![Open FTP / FTPS (File Search) in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dftp&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=ftp)

**Category:** [File Storage](../storage.md) · **Tools:** 10 · **Setup guide:** [anythingmcp.com](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/ftp)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the FTP / FTPS (File Search) connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The FTP / FTPS (File Search) connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your FTP / FTPS (File Search) account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/ftp).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ftp-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ftp-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ftp-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ftp-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ftp-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-ftp-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Find invoice INV-2026-0897 and confirm billed amount and invoice date*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["FTP / FTPS (File Search) API"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, user name and password" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the FTP / FTPS (File Search) credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (user name and password), calls FTP / FTPS (File Search), logs the call and returns the result.
- **FTP / FTPS (File Search)** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **FTP / FTPS (File Search)**, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
